theater: 帕米爾高原與瓦罕走廊

battle.name: 唐擊小勃律之戰
battle.theater: 帕米爾高原與瓦罕走廊
battle.brief: 公元七四七年三月，玄宗命安西副節度使高仙芝掛行營節度使，率步騎一萬人自龜茲出發，越過蔥嶺攻滅小勃律。卡面羅馬重步兵的年代遠早於此役，卻正點本役關鍵：先切斷小勃律通往吐蕃的印度河上游橋樑，斷其補給與外援，城池再險亦難守；唐軍自己遠征亦全靠沿途兵站與糧道。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 交戰一方是唐朝的安西都護府與安西四鎮的駐軍，指揮系統自玄宗朝發出：兵部擬策、宰相覆議，敕令安西都護府節度使執行。公元七四七年三月，玄宗以安西副節度使高仙芝為行營節度使，節制蕃漢混編的征討軍。參戰兵力以漢兵為骨幹，雜以龜茲、疏勒一帶的蕃兵與雇傭嚮導，安西都護府直屬的守捉兵沿途接應；高仙芝的隨軍有太監邊令誠充當監軍，部將有疏勒守捉使曹寬與撥換守捉使。另一方是小勃律國，本為唐的屬國，後與吐蕃王族聯姻而倒向吐蕃，被視作吐蕃控制帕米爾、扼住通往安西四鎮道路的橋樑堡壘；小勃律國主與守軍死守國都，吐蕃並自本土方向派出援軍，企圖在蔥嶺以南的河谷與唐軍主力決戰。整場戰爭的本質，是唐在安西四鎮外側，向吐蕃經營的中亞前哨發動的一次有限攻勢。
countriesEn: One side was the Protectorate of Anxi and the troops of the four Anxi garrisons of the Tang dynasty, with command running from the court of Emperor Xuanzong: the Ministry of War drew up the plan, the chancellors reviewed it, and the edict was handed to the jiedushi of the Protectorate to execute. In the third month of 747, Xuanzong appointed the deputy jiedushi of Anxi, Gao Xianzhi, as expeditionary jiedushi, putting him in command of a mixed Chinese and indigenous army. The backbone was Chinese soldiers, reinforced by local troops from the Kucha and Shule regions and by hired guides, while the Protectorate's own garrison units manned the relay posts along the route. Gao's staff included the eunuch Bian Lingcheng as supervisor of the army, and officers such as Cao Kuan, commandant of Shule, and the commandant of Poshuan. The other side was the kingdom of Little Bolü, originally a Tang vassal that had married into the Tibetan royal house and turned to Tibet, and which functioned as the Tibetan bridgehead on the Pamirs holding the road to the four Anxi garrisons. The king and the garrison of Little Bolü defended the capital stubbornly, and Tibet sent reinforcements from the direction of Tibet proper, hoping to destroy the Tang army in the valleys south of the Pamirs. In essence this was a limited Tang offensive launched outside the Anxi frontier against the Central Asian outposts through which Tibet held the region.
people: 高仙芝是本役唯一的主角。他原是安西都護裴行儉所賞識的部將，以通曉蕃語、能讀書寫字被拔擢，裴行儉在安西任上曾屢次舉薦他；開元年間他歷任石堡城使、崇儀副使等職，到天寶初年已累積近二十年西域軍務經驗。唐玄宗在封常清接掌安西軍、其後不久被調回京師之際，把出師的責任交給副節度使高仙芝，並特別下敕讓他掛行營節度使，率安西精銳越嶺。監軍太監邊令誠隨行，負責向朝廷傳遞軍報，是此役政治層面的關鍵人物。前任節度使夫蒙靈曜在吐蕃進攻安西時敗退，歷任節度使多次討伐小勃律皆無功而返，這些失敗正是高仙芝必須翻案的背景。小勃律一方的國主與王后在城破後被俘，姓名與下落史書多不詳；吐蕃援軍的統帥在通行戰史中亦多付闕如。可以確定的是，高仙芝此役後被擢為安西四鎮節度使，兩年後卻在怛羅斯大敗，四年後更在安史之亂的亂軍中被殺。
peopleEn: Gao Xianzhi is the only central figure of the campaign. He had been picked up by the Anxi Protector Pei Xingjian, who appreciated his fluency in the Tibetan language and his literacy, and recommended him repeatedly while serving in the western regions. Through the Kaiyuan era he served as commandant of Shibao city and as assistant director of the court of ceremony, and by the first years of the Tianbao era he had accumulated nearly twenty years of experience in western campaigns. After Feng Changqing had taken over the Anxi command and was soon afterwards recalled to the capital, Emperor Xuanzong entrusted the expedition to the deputy jiedushi Gao Xianzhi, specially issuing an edict that he should serve as expeditionary jiedushi and lead the picked troops of Anxi across the mountains. The eunuch Bian Lingcheng accompanied him as supervisor and carried reports back to the court, and was the politically decisive figure of the operation. The previous jiedushi, Fu Meng Lingyao, had been beaten back by the Tibetan offensive against Anxi, and earlier jiedushi had repeatedly campaigned against Little Bolü and returned without result; those failures form the background against which Gao Xianzhi had to reverse the record. The king and queen of Little Bolü were captured when the city fell, and neither their names nor their later fates are recorded in the surviving histories; the commander of the Tibetan relief force is likewise missing from the usual narratives. What is certain is that Gao Xianzhi was promoted to jiedushi of the four Anxi garrisons after this victory, was beaten two years later at Talas, and was killed in the disorder of the An Lushan rebellion four years after that.
kits: 卡面的羅馬重步兵是公元前一世紀的裝備：分段鎧甲加大型曲面重盾，羅馬軍隊的戰力來自兵源補充與補給線，而不是靠重裝。這支部隊在七四七年的帕米爾高原既不可能出現，也不會是任何一方的制勝裝備，只能當作年代卡看待。不過它標示的那條邏輯，在這場戰爭裡完全成立：唐軍真正得手的一擊，是切斷小勃律通往吐蕃與大勃律的印度河上游橋樑，等於斬斷對方的補給線，斷糧的守軍再厚也撐不住。唐軍實際的裝備是步騎混編：步兵以長柄橫刀、長槊為主，配弓弩，鎧甲有札甲與明光甲一類的鐵片裝備；騎兵攜馬槊與環首刀，馬匹是跨越高原的唯一載具，也是全線最脆弱的一環。攻城與壓制堡壘靠配重砲、投石機與床弩。小勃律與吐蕃援軍則以弓箭、長矛、彎刀為主，依托山地堡壘與石砌城牆。全部糧秣、箭矢與傷員都靠馱馬與人力，萬里之外的安西都護府是唯一補給源。
kitsEn: The Roman legionary on the card is a first-century-BC equipment set: segmented armour and a large curved scutum, with the Roman fighting power resting on the replacement of manpower and on supply lines rather than on heavy armour. Such troops could not have appeared on the Pamir plateau in 747, and they would not have decided the outcome for either side; the card can only be read as a period marker. Yet the logic it points at holds completely in this war: the blow that actually won for the Tang was the cutting of the bridge over the upper Indus that linked Little Bolü with Tibet and with Greater Bolü, which severed the enemy's supply line, and a besieged force without food holds out however many men it has. The actual Tang equipment was a mixed force of foot and horse: infantry fought with long-hilted single-edged sabres and long spears, supported by bows and crossbows, and wore lamellar and brigandine-type armour of iron plates; the cavalry carried long cavalry lances and ring-pommel sabres, and horses were the only transport over the high plateau, as well as the most fragile element of the whole line. Siege operations and the suppression of the fortified positions relied on traction trebuchets, stone-throwing engines and large crossbows. Little Bolü and the Tibetan relief force fought with bows, spears and curved sabres, holding mountain positions and the stone walls of the citadel. All grain, arrows and wounded had to be carried by pack animals and by men, and the Protectorate of Anxi thousands of miles away was the only source of supply.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術核心是超遠程的縱深機動與斷糧迫降。第一步是行軍：自安西都護府所在的龜茲出發，十五日抵撥換城，又十五日抵握瑟德，再十五日至疏勒，二十日上蔥嶺守捉，沿途逐段設守捉兵站，一站一站向前推移，人馬糧秣在每個驛站重新裝載。雪線以上的條件極差，蔥嶺一線海拔高達四千米至七千七百米，馬匹掉膘、人畜喘息，行程被迫拉長。第二步是分進合擊：在特勤漫川一帶分三路，疏勒方向一隊取山谷道，撥換方向一隊取赤谷路，高仙芝自與太監邊令誠走秘密國一路，三路約期會合，攻擊吐蕃主力駐守的連雲城；合擊在夜中發動，先以火攻與衝鋒打散密集隊形，再全線追擊。第三步是斷援攻城：先切斷印度河上通往吐蕃與大勃律的橋樑，使小勃律失去外援，再逼其開城。整套打法沒有正面硬攻高山堡壘，贏在速度與補給線。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of this war was an advance of extraordinary depth combined with a surrender forced by cutting supplies. The first step was the march: the column left Kucha, seat of the Anxi Protectorate, reached Poshuan in fifteen days, Dexian in another fifteen, Shule in another fifteen, and the Pamir post at Congling twenty days further, the relay posts pushing the army forward stage by stage, with horses, grain and men reloaded at every station. The conditions above the snow line were brutal: the Congling posts lay between four thousand and seven thousand seven hundred metres above sea level, where horses lost condition and both men and animals laboured for breath, so the schedule had to be stretched. The second step was the converging attack. Around Teqinmancuan the force was split into three: one column took the valley road from the Shule side, one the Chigu road from Poshuan, while Gao Xianzhi, with the eunuch Bian Lingcheng, entered by way of the country of Mimi; the three were to meet and fall on the Tibetan main force at the fortress of Lianyun. The blow fell at night, fire and shock breaking the dense enemy formation, followed by pursuit along the whole line. The third step was to cut the aid and then reduce the city: the bridge on the upper Indus that carried supplies from Tibet and Greater Bolü was destroyed first, leaving Little Bolü without help, and only then was the city compelled to open its gates. No frontal assault on the mountain fortresses was attempted; the victory belonged to speed and to the supply line.
data: 可核對的數字不多，諸說並存，須分層看。兵力方面，通行敘述記高仙芝率步騎一萬人；《新唐書》則記蕃漢三萬眾，兩說相差三倍，實戰中投入的蕃漢混編兵力當在一萬上下，尚有沿途守捉與後續部隊未計在內。行軍日程可由行程推算：龜茲至撥換城十五日，撥換城至握瑟德十五日，握瑟德至疏勒十五日，疏勒至蔥嶺守捉二十日，其後每段仍以二十日為一程，全程以日行一程的驛站節奏推進。地理數字上，蔥嶺守捉一線的海拔為四千米至七千七百米，是全線最致命的一段。戰果方面，記載唐軍在連雲城一戰斬吐蕃兵約五千、俘約千人，虜獲軍資器械不可勝數；小勃律國主與王后隨城開而降，國都被迫交出。兩年後的怛羅斯之敗則是另一組數字：唐軍全軍覆沒，殘部歸國者僅存原數的一二成。
dataEn: Few figures can be verified, and where they differ they must be read with care. On strength, the common account gives Gao Xianzhi ten thousand foot and horse; the Xin Tangshu instead records three tens of thousands of Chinese and indigenous troops, a threefold discrepancy, and the mixed force actually committed was probably around ten thousand, excluding the garrison posts along the route and the follow-up units. The schedule can be reconstructed from the itinerary: fifteen days from Kucha to Poshuan, fifteen more to Dexian, fifteen more to Shule, twenty days to the Congling post, and thereafter twenty days for each further stage, the whole advance moving at the rhythm of one relay stage a day. On geography, the Congling posts lay between four thousand and seven thousand seven hundred metres above sea level, the deadliest stretch of the line. On results, the record gives roughly five thousand Tibetan soldiers killed and about a thousand taken prisoner at Lianyun, with enemy stores and weapons taken beyond counting; the king and queen of Little Bolü surrendered with the city, and the capital was handed over. The other set of numbers belongs to Talas two years later: the Tang army was destroyed, and only one or two tenths of its strength came home.
cause: 打起來的原因是地緣與交通：小勃律是吐蕃通往安西四鎮的交通要道，本為唐的屬國，吐蕃以宗室女嫁其國主聯姻之後，小勃律倒向吐蕃，吐蕃藉此控制西北諸國，出現西北二十餘國俱歸吐蕃的局面，安西四鎮與唐對中亞的商道同時受威脅。唐廷歷任安西節度使多次出兵討伐，據載皆無功而返，邊防局勢被動。玄宗朝轉而尋求進攻方案，決心在安西四鎮之外切斷吐蕃的中亞支點，把小勃律從吐蕃手中奪回，切實打通安西四鎮至小勃律的商道與情報線。促成出兵的另一個條件是人事：安西軍經常由熟悉蕃地的高級將領主持，裴行儉一手提拔的高仙芝在西域軍中歷練多年，通曉蕃語、熟悉山川形勢，與太監邊令誠同時被選入行營，顯示朝廷此役並非只求一城一地，而是要打通整條蔥嶺外的路。作為背景，七四六年前後吐蕃曾大舉進攻安西，前任節度使夫蒙靈曜敗退，唐方在安西的處境一度相當危急，這也是朝廷改採主動出擊的直接理由。
causeEn: The war began for reasons of geography and communication. Little Bolü was the road by which Tibet reached the four Anxi garrisons. It had been a Tang vassal, but after Tibet married one of its royal women to the king of Little Bolü, the kingdom turned to Tibet; Tibet then controlled the northwestern states, producing a situation in which more than twenty states of the northwest were all under Tibetan sway, and both the four Anxi garrisons and the Tang trade road into Central Asia were threatened. Successive Anxi commanders had campaigned against Little Bolü and by the record all returned without result, so the frontier was passive. The Xuanzong court turned instead to a plan of attack: to cut the Central Asian pivot held by Tibet by taking Little Bolü away from it, so as to open the road and the intelligence line running from the four Anxi garrisons to Little Bolü. A second condition for the expedition was personnel. Command in Anxi was habitually given to senior officers who knew the Tibetan regions, and Gao Xianzhi, raised by Pei Xingjian, had served for years in the western army, spoke the local language and knew the mountains and the roads; he and the eunuch Bian Lingcheng were chosen for the expeditionary command, which shows that the court was not after a single town but after the whole road beyond the Pamirs. The immediate background was the Tibetan offensive against Anxi around 746, when the preceding jiedushi Fu Meng Lingyao was beaten back and the Tang position in the west became critical; this was the direct reason for switching to an active counter-stroke.
impact: 這一戰的意義在於把唐的邊界推出安西四鎮之外。破小勃律之後，唐廷於其地置金城郡、設威遠軍鎮守，把原來游離於唐、吐之間的小國收編進安西都護府的羈縻體系；消息傳開，西域諸國震服，先前歸附吐蕃的西北諸國紛紛改觀，兩年後高仙芝再率軍攻入吐火羅，擒其國主，把唐的影響推到今中亞的巴克特里亞一帶。然而頂點也緊接著來。公元七五一年怛羅斯之戰，葛邏祿部眾倒戈與大食夾擊，唐軍全軍覆沒，安西四鎮與帕米爾外線的屏障重歸崩解，兩年來的成果幾乎一朝散盡；又有記載說小勃律國主在怛羅斯被大食方面處死，各書說法不一，姑存其疑。七五五年安史之亂爆發，唐廷把西北精銳調回內地，防守重心移往關中與河東，安西的經營在混亂中廢弛，小勃律一帶隨即脫離唐的羈縻，成為唐在西域經營由盛轉衰的一個標記。高仙芝本人則在七五六年唐玄宗奔蜀的亂局中被殺，一場邊疆大捷的主將最終死於內變，是這段歷史最刺眼的對照。
impactEn: The meaning of this victory was that it pushed the Tang frontier beyond the four Anxi garrisons. After Little Bolü fell, the court set up the prefecture of Jincheng there and garrisoned it with the Weiyuan Army, drawing a state that had drifted between Tang and Tibet into the administrative net of the Anxi Protectorate. The news spread, the western states were shaken, and the northwestern states that had followed Tibet changed their reckoning, so that two years later Gao Xianzhi marched into Tokharistan, captured its king, and carried Tang influence as far as Bactria in Central Asia. The summit, however, came immediately after. At Talas in 751 the Karluk tribes turned against the Tang while the Abbasids attacked from the other side, the army was annihilated, and the screen protecting Anxi and the outer Pamir line collapsed, undoing in a few days what had taken two years to build. There are also accounts, with the sources differing, that the king of Little Bolü was put to death by the Abbasid side at Talas; the point is left open. When the An Lushan rebellion broke out in 755, the court pulled the best troops of the northwest back to the interior, the defensive centre of gravity moved to Guanzhong and Hedong, the Anxi establishment lapsed in the disorder, and Little Bolü slipped out of Tang control, becoming a marker of the turn from expansion to retreat in the western regions. Gao Xianzhi himself was killed in 756 amid the rout that followed the emperor's flight to Shu; a general who won his greatest victory on the frontier died in a mutiny at home, and that contrast is the sharpest point of this history.
result: 結果是唐軍完勝，但勝利範圍極窄。高仙芝在連雲城擊潰吐蕃援軍主力，斬約五千、俘約千人、奪獲軍資器械不可勝數，隨後切斷印度河上游通往吐蕃與大勃律的橋樑，使小勃律失去外援；國都被迫開城，小勃律國主與王后被俘，其國被置為金城郡，另設威遠軍鎮守。消息傳回長安，玄宗大悅，升高仙芝為左金吾衛大將軍，仍兼安西四鎮節度使，此役也成為他生平最得意的一役。與此同時，忠於唐室的同一支軍隊的命運也埋下伏筆：七五一年怛羅斯之戰，唐軍被葛邏祿倒戈與大食夾擊，萬里之外的孤軍沒有任何預備隊可補，裴行儉與高仙芝兩代經營的西域局勢在幾日之內崩壞；七五五年安史之亂起，西北邊軍內調，小勃律與金城郡在唐廷自顧不暇中失去聯繫，兩年後唐的勢力退出河西，最終連安西四鎮也守不住。回頭看，這場以斷糧逼降、越嶺奇襲取勝的戰爭，本身幾乎是一場以補給線取勝的示範；它同時也說明，唐在西域能靠一次千里奔襲得到一座城，卻守不住一條路，除非朝廷能一直維持那條路上的兵站與糧道。
resultEn: The result was a complete Tang victory, but a narrow one. Gao Xianzhi broke the main body of the Tibetan relief force at Lianyun, killing about five thousand and taking about a thousand prisoners, and seized enemy stores and weapons beyond counting; he then cut the bridge on the upper Indus that carried supplies from Tibet and Greater Bolü, and Little Bolü lost its support. The capital was compelled to open, the king and queen of Little Bolü were taken, their country was reorganised as the prefecture of Jincheng and garrisoned by the Weiyuan Army. When the news reached Chang'an, Xuanzong was delighted and raised Gao Xianzhi to be Left Jinwu Guard commander while he continued to hold the four Anxi garrisons; this was the proudest victory of his life. At the same time the fate of that same army was already being prepared. At Talas in 751, betrayed by the Karluk turn and caught between the Abbasids and the mountains, an isolated army in far-off lands had no reserve to draw on, and the position in the western regions that Pei Xingjian and Gao Xianzhi had built over two generations collapsed within days. When the An Lushan rebellion began in 755, the frontier troops of the northwest were moved inward, Little Bolü and the prefecture of Jincheng lost contact with a court preoccupied with its own survival, and two years later the Tang withdrew from Hexi; in the end even the four Anxi garrisons could not be held. Seen afterwards, this war was in effect a demonstration of winning through supply lines, and it showed the same truth from the other side: the Tang could seize a city with a single raid of a thousand miles, but could not keep a road unless the court maintained the relay posts and the grain convoys along it.
